title: Harper Oisiris Seventh Meeting

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: Out of reach for an unemployed silicon weaver though.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Out of reach for an unemployed silicon weaver though.

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: You sure?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You sure?

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: Maybe...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe...

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: Well... it's been an experience. See you around. Maybe.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well... it's been an experience. See you around. Maybe.

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: So my brother is dead?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So my brother is dead?

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: I knew it. I knew he was gone. I felt it. I just... I didn't know he helped me out in the end.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I knew it. I knew he was gone. I felt it. I just... I didn't know he helped me out in the end.

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: Sure. Makes sense. Why would you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure. Makes sense. Why would you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Three hundred Lims for a new life?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Three hundred Lims for a new life?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Three hundred Lims for a new life?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Three hundred Lims for a new life?

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: Three Hundred Lims for a new life.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Three Hundred Lims for a new life.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's a lot...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's a lot...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Not that much for a new life.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not that much for a new life.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Not that much for a new life.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Not that much for a new life.

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: Especially for an unemployed silicon weaver.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Especially for an unemployed silicon weaver.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe I could still help?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe I could still help?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe you can ask around for help.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe you can ask around for help.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Maybe you can ask around for help.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Maybe you can ask around for help.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I want to help. Here you go. (-300 Lims)

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I want to help. Here you go. (-300 Lims)
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I want to help. Here you go. (-300 Lims)
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I want to help. Here you go. (-300 Lims)

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Good luck with everything!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good luck with everything!

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: I appreciate it. I've been through a lot. I guess we all have. But this will really help. I probably won't be able to pay you back for a while, so... thank you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I appreciate it. I've been through a lot. I guess we all have. But this will really help. I probably won't be able to pay you back for a while, so... thank you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're welcome, Harper. Good luck.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're welcome, Harper. Good luck.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're right. I should save my Lims.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're right. I should save my Lims.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You're right. I should save my Lims.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You're right. I should save my Lims.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yes. He... he sacrificed himself for you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes. He... he sacrificed himself for you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yes. He... he sacrificed himself for you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yes. He... he sacrificed himself for you.

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: Danny told me you don't want to pay.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Danny told me you don't want to pay.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yes, I can't help.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, I can't help.

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: You had a chance to help before.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You had a chance to help before.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's too much for me at the moment.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's too much for me at the moment.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It's too much for me at the moment.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It's too much for me at the moment.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What now?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What now?

nodes.speaker: Harper Osiris
nodes.text: I need to find Three Hundred Lims for my records to be scrubbed clean and a fresh start.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I need to find Three Hundred Lims for my records to be scrubbed clean and a fresh start.
